fullDescription: Editorial magazine-style login: warm cream + burgundy palette, oversized Fraunces serif "Welcome back." greeting with a testimonial, split against a clean Google-SSO + email sign-in card.

structured.summary: An editorial, magazine-inspired login page. A full-bleed two-column split pairs a warm cream serif greeting panel (oversized Fraunces 'Welcome back.' headline with an italic burgundy accent, an issue/volume kicker, and a serif testimonial blockquote) against a clean sign-in card with Google SSO, email + password fields, a custom checkbox, and a deep-burgundy primary button. A sticky translucent nav sits on top. The whole thing reads like the cover of a design quarterly rather than a generic auth screen.

style.description: Refined print-editorial aesthetic on a warm paper-cream canvas (#faf6ef) with near-black ink text (#1c1815) and a single burgundy accent (#7b2d3b, deepening to #5e1f2b on hover). Display copy is set in Fraunces (an optical serif) at light/regular weights with tight tracking and italic accents; UI/labels are Inter at 400-600. Subtle radial tints, a faint multiply grain texture, hairline rules, and tabular index numerals give it tactile, letterpress-like depth. Generous whitespace, soft 12-28px rounded corners, hairline ink/10-15 borders, and quiet micro-interactions (focus ring rgba(123,45,59,.10), animated link underlines).
style.prompt: Design a warm, editorial print-magazine UI. Background paper cream #faf6ef, primary ink text #1c1815, single accent burgundy #7b2d3b (hover/deep #5e1f2b). Typography: Fraunces optical serif for all display/headlines (weights 300-500, tight -0.02em tracking, italic accent words in burgundy) and Inter for labels, buttons and body UI (400-600). Surfaces use hairline borders (ink at 10-15% opacity), 12-28px rounded corners, and white-at-60% input fills that brighten to #fffdf9 on focus with a 4px rgba(123,45,59,.10) focus ring. Add print texture: subtle radial-gradient burgundy tints, a faint multiply dot grain (radial-gradient dots, 4px tile, ~5% black, .5 opacity), thin gradient rules that fade to transparent, oversized tabular-num index numerals at low opacity, animated 1px link underlines that grow on hover. Tone: quiet, confident, tactile, like a design quarterly.

layout_and_structure.description: A sticky translucent header over a full-bleed two-column split that fills the viewport (min-height calc(100vh - 68px)). Desktop columns are an asymmetric 1.05fr / 0.95fr grid with the editorial greeting on the left and the sign-in form on the right; the outer container is capped at max-width 1240px with px-6/sm:px-8 gutters. On mobile the grid collapses to one column and the order flips so the form sits on top (order-1) and the editorial panel below (order-2), with the rounded corners moving from a left/right split (lg:rounded-l-[28px] / rounded-r-[28px]) to a stacked top/bottom split (rounded-t/rounded-b-[24px]).

prompts.prompt: Sticky top header, z-50, cream at 85% opacity with backdrop-blur and a bottom border ink/10, 68px tall, content capped at max-width 1240px. Left: brand lockup = an 8x8 burgundy circle holding an italic serif 'A' in cream, beside a 19px serif 'Atelier' (weight 500). Center (hidden below md): 4 link-underline nav items (Library, Showcase, Pricing, Docs) at 14px, ink/70. Right: a muted 'New here?' label (hidden on small) plus a pill 'Create account' button: burgundy text, burgundy/30 hairline border that darkens on hover, fully rounded, px-4 py-1.5.

Left column on a textured panel (#f3ece0 base with two soft burgundy radial-gradient tints + an absolute grain overlay), hairline ink/10 border, large left/bottom rounded corners. Flex column with space-between across three blocks. Top: an uppercase 0.22em-tracked burgundy kicker 'The Design Library' preceded by an 8px burgundy rule line. Middle (max 30ch): a small uppercase 'Vol. 06 · June Edition' eyebrow, then a giant Fraunces headline clamp(2.6rem,6.2vw,4.6rem) reading 'Welcome' / italic burgundy 'back.' on two lines, leading 0.96; below it a light serif sub-sentence at clamp(1.15rem,2vw,1.45rem). Bottom: a figure with a fading hairline rule, a light serif blockquote opened by an oversized burgundy swash quote-mark, and a figcaption avatar (burgundy/15 circle, italic serif initial) + name 'Mara Velez · Product Designer, Northbound'.

Right column, cream background, vertically centered, content capped at max-width 400px and centered. Header row: a stacked uppercase 'Member sign in' label + a 2rem serif 'Sign in' heading, balanced against an oversized low-opacity serif tabular index numeral '01' (burgundy/25) on the right. Then a full-width Google SSO button (white/60 fill, ink/15 hairline border, rounded-xl, py-3, logos:google-icon + 'Continue with Google'). An 'or with email' divider made of two ink/12 hairlines around an uppercase label. A form (space-y-5): an Email field (label + rounded-xl white/60 input, placeholder you@studio.com), a Password field with a label row that also holds a small burgundy 'Forgot?' link and an input with a trailing ph:eye toggle. A custom 'Keep me signed in for 30 days' checkbox: an 18px rounded-[5px] burgundy box with a cream ph:check-bold. A full-width burgundy primary submit button 'Sign in to your canvas' (rounded-xl, py-3.5, cream text, lifts/darkens to #5e1f2b on hover with a soft shadow). Below: centered 'Don't have an account? Start designing free' (burgundy link) and a fine-print Terms & Privacy line at 11.5px.

special_ui_components.prompt: Animated link underline (link-underline): a 1px burgundy gradient line that grows from 0% to 100% width on hover via background-size transition.
Custom checkbox: an 18px rounded-[5px] burgundy-filled box with a burgundy/40 border holding a cream ph:check-bold icon, replacing the native input.
Oversized editorial index numeral: a serif tabular-nums '01' at ~2.4rem in burgundy/25, used as a decorative section index beside the form heading.
Swash quote-mark: an oversized burgundy serif opening quote with OpenType swash/ss01 features, vertically offset to sit into the blockquote.
Textured editorial panel (ed-panel + grain): a layered radial-gradient burgundy tint base plus an absolutely-positioned multiply dot-grain overlay for a printed-paper feel.
Input focus treatment: fields shift to #fffdf9, border to burgundy, with a 4px rgba(123,45,59,.10) focus ring.
Password reveal: a trailing ph:eye icon button inside the password field.
Pill outline button: the fully-rounded burgundy-outline 'Create account' nav CTA.

structured.special_notes: Fonts loaded from Google Fonts: Fraunces (ital, optical-size, weights 300-700) for all serif/display, Inter (400/500/600) for sans UI. Icons via Iconify (logos:google-icon, ph:eye, ph:check-bold). Built with the Tailwind CDN; custom theme tokens cream #faf6ef, ink #1c1815, burgundy #7b2d3b, burgundy-deep #5e1f2b. Responsive: desktop 1.05fr/0.95fr split with corner rounding on the outer edges; below lg it stacks to one column, reorders the form above the editorial panel, and switches to top/bottom corner rounding. No em-dashes in copy. The whole layout fills the viewport height minus the 68px nav. Selection color is burgundy-on-cream.
